primaryModel.primaryEstimator: prespecified mixed-effects model with superblock pairing
primaryModel.nonconvergenceFallback: same fixed-effect formula with superblock-cluster-robust covariance

confirmatoryFamily.D1IntersectionUnion: for each comparator, domain p-value is max of geometric-mean and P95 one-sided p-values; both simultaneous intervals must be entirely below ratio 1
confirmatoryFamily.D2ToD4NullBoundary: ratio or ratio-like contrast equals 1 on the declared scale
confirmatoryFamily.domainPass: valid hard gates plus at least four of the five target-versus-comparator hypotheses rejected after Holm with favorable direction and simultaneous intervals
confirmatoryFamily.domainPassOutput: integer 1 when the rule passes, otherwise integer 0
confirmatoryFamily.failedComparatorReporting: for every failed comparator hypothesis, report effect, simultaneous interval, Holm-adjusted p-value, and concrete failure explanation
confirmatoryFamily.cFFRole: one of the five domain-gating comparators; if its hypothesis fails, report the same complete failure details
confirmatoryFamily.primaryClaimPass: at least four of seven domains have domainPass equal to 1

mipeInterpretation.mandatoryReporting: For every IDFF-comparator domain contrast, report estimate, interval, adjusted p-value, direction, MIPE flag, and hypothesis pass status.

secondaryReporting.fullFifteenPairMatrices: exploratory, separately multiplicity controlled, never ordered or ranked

hardGates.correctnessOracle: all frozen path-status, version, legality, and reference-oracle checks retained
hardGates.gateFailureAfterCollection: affected domain remains in denominator and cannot pass

ruleRevision.previousAttemptStatus: superseded because it interpreted the four comparators as a fixed subset excluding C-FF
ruleRevision.correctedRule: any four of the same five formal comparator hypotheses
